headline: Plaza Wires submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
summary: Plaza Wires Limited has submitted the scrutinizer report and voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a standard corporate compliance filing detailing shareholder votes on resolutions presented at the AGM. Plaza Wires shares are listed on the NSE and BSE. Routine filings of this nature have no immediate impact on share price or company fundamentals for retail investors.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on share price.
